title: Reduce client footprint and clean deprecated API params across Python/JS/Go SDKs
creator: Riley Chen
description:
Summary: Coordinate a cross-language dependency bump and API surface pruning to reduce SDK binary size, remove legacy parameters, and ensure backwards-compatible migration paths. This ticket owns the orchestration, acceptance criteria, and rollout for the multi-repo changes across the Python, JavaScript, and Go clients.

Background: Over time the SDKs accumulated compatibility shims and heavy transitive deps (legacy fetch shims, old JSON schema libs, large runtime type systems) that increase install size and maintenance burden. Multiple language-specific PRs were prepared but lacked an aligned rollout, migration docs, and opt-out fallbacks for higher-tier customers. Goal is to finish the work, validate correctness with end-to-end smoke tests and CI, and publish migration guides and deprecation notices.

Scope:
- Bump and audit key dependencies in the Python, JS, and Go clients for security and size improvements.
- Remove deprecated API surface: legacy request fields (legacy_context, old_metadata), old streaming wrapper parameters, and fallback shims that duplicate runtime behavior.
- Add automated compatibility tests that exercise both old and new parameter shapes to ensure safe rollouts.
- Publish migration guides and coordinated changelogs.
- Measure client install size / bundle size reduction and report token-level cost impact if applicable.
acceptance_criteria:
- Python, JS, and Go CI green for mainline with new deps and shims removed.
- No regressions in core e2e test suite (chat generation, embeddings, streaming).
- Migration guide published in the docs site and linked in SDK changelogs.
- Rollout plan that supports canary (5% traffic) and automatic fallback for failing customers.
- Measured install/bundle size reduced by >=10% for at least two clients (Python wheel size and JS bundle gzipped).
- Security scan clean (no critical CVEs introduced by upgrades).
tasks: Audit transitive deps across python-sdk, js-sdk, go-sdk and produce a delta report
Python: upgrade pydantic to 2.4+, switch http client to httpx stable, remove requests-legacy shim and regenerate compatible type hints
JS: replace cross-fetch with native fetch/undici, remove legacy response wrapper, upgrade zod/type libs and update runtime validators
Go: tidy module replacements, upgrade go1.21 minimum, remove legacy proto wrapper used by older endpoints
Add compatibility tests that send payloads using old parameter names and validate graceful deprecation warnings
Create migration guide + changelog entries per-language and a consolidated deprecation timeline
Open PRs per repo and link them in this ticket; coordinate merge window and canary rollout
Measure bundle/wheel size before and after and record results in the ticket attachments
